employer_match.formula_readable: Capital One matches 100% on the first 3% of eligible pay contributed, and 50% on the next 3% of eligible pay contributed, for a maximum matching contribution of 4.5% of eligible pay. To receive the maximum match, an associate must contribute at least 6% of eligible pay. Matching contributions are not made on amounts over 6% of eligible pay. At year-end, Capital One may provide a true-up matching contribution if the associate did not receive the maximum match during the year, provided the associate is actively employed on December 31 (with exceptions for retirement, permanent disability, death, or job elimination).

employee_contributions.formula_readable: Employees are always 100% vested in their own Associate Elective Contributions (pre-tax, Roth, and catch-up), pre-2008 after-tax contributions, and rollover contributions immediately.

immediate_vest_triggers: Reaching age 65 while an active associate
Becoming permanently and totally disabled during the plan year
employer_match.formula_readable: Matching Company Contributions vest 100% after completing two years of service. Before two years, the employee is not vested and forfeits unvested matching contributions upon leaving. Vesting also occurs immediately upon reaching age 65, permanent and total disability, or death during the plan year.

nonelective.formula_readable: The 3% Basic Non-Elective Company Contributions (basic safe-harbor non-elective contributions) vest immediately, along with earnings on those contributions.

nonelective_contribution.formula_readable: Capital One automatically contributes 3% of eligible pay to each eligible associate's account each pay period, regardless of whether the associate is actively contributing to the Plan. Associates are 100% vested in these contributions immediately.

eligibility.formula_readable: You are eligible for the Associate Savings Plan if you are at least 18 years of age and are a full-time or part-time associate of Capital One or an affiliate that has adopted the Plan. Participation begins on your first day of work.
